Functionality.description: Create and Manage Less Finish, Color Parts, Color Assemblies and their Usages in a Product and associate Color definitions to enable downstream consumption.
Functionality.name: Cb1awcolorbom

Library.description: A service library for Color BOM management.
Library.name: Cb1SoaColorBom

ServiceInterface.description: This service provides operations related to the color and appearance management on BOM structure.
ServiceInterface.name: ColorBomManagement

Struct.description: A service operation output structure containing information about color themes.
Struct.name: ColorThemesAndPartsResponse

StructElement.description: Contains created or updated objects, as well as any partial errors that occurred during the operation. Plain objects include modified less finish elements and color appearances.
StructElement.name: serviceData

StructElement.description: A JSON-formatted output string containing information about color themes and assigned color apperances for the less finish part occurrences or appearance areas in the BOM. This string should adhere to the JSON schema for color themes defined in colorThemesAndPartsReqRespJson_Schema.json; please refer to schema and sample color themes defined %TC_DATA%/json/cb1awcolorbom/schema for details.
StructElement.name: colorThemesJsonOutput

Typedef.description: A map (string, list of string) of preference names and values. Preference names and values are case sensitive. Allowed request preference names are : "clearAllColorThemes", "includeActiveThemesOnly", “createColorParts”. Allowed values are: true or false.
Typedef.name: RequestPref

OperationTemplate.description: This operation allows the user to define new color themes or retrieve existing color themes associated with the provided scope object, which can be Item Revision, Partition, or Product BOM. To retrieve existing color themes and their associated color appearances, the operation takes less finish part elements or appearance area objects as input. To associate new color appearances to the less finish part elements or appearance areas, the operation accepts color theme information in JSON format. The operation also allows user to create the color parts from the less finish parts based on the color appearances assigned in a color theme.
OperationTemplate.name: Cb1::Soa::ColorBom::ColorBomManagement::manageColorThemesAndParts
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The operation returns a list of color themes in JSON format as output. The JSON schema includes the color theme and the associated color appearances for all less finish part occurrences or appearance areas defined in BOM.

Following partial errors may be returned:
489001: The provided color theme scope object is invalid.
77143 : The JSON schema validation for color theme input JSON has failed.

OperationParameter.description: A scope object to which the color themes are associated, such as ItemRevision, Partition, or Product BOM.
OperationParameter.name: colorThemeScopeObject

OperationParameter.description: A list of objects of type Awb0Element or Clr0AppearanceArea to which color appearances are assigned in the color themes associated with the input scope object.
OperationParameter.name: appearanceApplicableObjects

OperationParameter.description: A JSON-formatted input string containing information about color themes and their color appearances to be associated to the less finish part elements or appearance areas defined in BOM. This string should adhere to the JSON schema for color themes defined in colorThemesAndPartsReqRespJson_Schema.json; please refer to schema and sample color themes defined at %TC_DATA%/json/cb1awcolorbom/schema for details.
OperationParameter.name: colorThemesJsonInput

OperationParameter.description: A map (string, list of string) of preference names and values. Preference names and values are case sensitive. Allowed preference names are:"clearAllColorThemes", "includeActiveThemesOnly","createColorParts". Allowed values are: true or false.
OperationParameter.name: requestPref

Usecase 1: Assigning color appearances for color themes associated to scope object
User should be able to assign new color appearances to the less finish part occurrences in a set of color themes defined for color theme scope object. In the example user wants to assign new color appearances to the less finish part elements of door assembly under a partition interior scope.

The input and output of the service request are as follows:
Input:
colorThemeScopeObject: Partition Interior
appearanceApplicableObjects: []
colorThemesJsonInput:-
{
    “jsonType”: “ColorThemesJSON”,
    “version”: “1.1”,
     colorThemesAndPartsInfo”:
     “[{
            “Theme”: “RedBlueTheme”,
            “VariantCriteria”: “Product Models=Basic &
                                Interior Colors=Dynamic Red Blue”,
            “ColorSpecifications”:
            [
                {
                    “appearanceApplicableObject”: “DoorUpperElement”,
                    “colorAppearances”:[“ColorObjectRed”]
                },
                {
                    “appearanceApplicableObject”: “DoorPanelLowerElement”,
                    “colorAppearances”:[“ColorObjectBlue”]                
                }
            ]
        },
    {
            “Theme”: “GreenGrayTheme”,
            “VariantCriteria”: “Product Models=Premium &
                                    Interior Colors=Sports Green Gray”,
            “ColorSpecification”:
            [
                {
                    “appearanceApplicableObject”:“DoorUpperElement”,
                    “colorAppearances”:[“ColorObjectGray”]

                },
                {
                    “appearanceApplicableObject”:“DoorPanelLowerElement”,
                    “colorAppearances”:[“ColorObjectGreen”]

                }
            ]
    }]”
}

Output:
JSON formatted output string containing information about the color themes which got the color appearances assigned successfully. The response also contains the partial errors if any were encountered during the operation.

Usecase 2:Get the themes associated to Partition Interior
User should be able to retrieve the existing color appearances assigned to less finish part occurrences in a set of color themes defined for color theme scope object. In the example, the user wants to retrieve existing color appearances assigned to the less finish part elements of the door assembly under a partition interior scope.

The input and output of the service request are as follows:

appearanceApplicableObjects: [Door Upper, Door Panel Lower]

Usecase 3:Create color parts for associated color themes
User should be able to create color parts for less finish parts based on the color themes associated to the scope object. In the example user wants to create color parts for the less finish parts belonging to the Partition Interior based on defined color themes. The service operation creates new color parts or reuses the existing color parts if already available for a less finish part and its assigned color appearance.

The input and output of the service request are as follows:
Input:
colorThemeScopeObject: Partition Interior
appearanceApplicableObjects: [Door Assembly]
colorThemesJsonInput:[]
requestPref:[“createColorParts”, {“True”}]

Output:
